en.sayed-ali-raza: Glory be to Allāh from Whom neither the blackness of dark dusk
or of gloomy night (falling) in the low parts of the earth
is hidden, nor the thundering of clouds on the horizons of the skies,
nor the sparking of lightning in the clouds,
nor the falling of leaves blown away from their falling places by the winds of hurricanes or by downpour from the sky.
He knows where the drops. fall and where they stay,
where the grubs leave their trails or where they drag themselves,
what livelihood would suffice the mosquitoes
and what a female bears in its womb.
